author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.23 shipped: HVAC: a person's thermostat change ends URA's temporary change; pre-arrival pre-cool ends on arrival, window or interrupt
summary: HVAC: a person's thermostat change ends URA's temporary change; pre-arrival pre-cool ends on arrival, window or interrupt
why: On 09-28 zone 2 sat in a URA pre-arrival pre-cool manual hold for up to 2 hours; a person set 71 twice and the arrester could not see it (it only watched transitions INTO manual) and stood aside for the live borrow, and a restart then restored Away over the person. The operator ruled: the person interrupts, URA ends its change and reverts (Home for pre-arrivals). Built as Tier 2-DB with a 4th completeness reviewer; three fix-up rounds closed 3 medium leaks per round-1 D review, 3 more in round 2 (stale latch, re-begin within an arrival, case-B away revert) and one low in round 3; 164 per-site mutation drills, name-diff clean.
implications: Shipped ARRESTER-BOOT-BLIND-1, HVAC-PRE-ARRIVAL-BORROW-LIFETIME-1, HVAC-RELOADING-ROOM-PLACEHOLDER-READERS-1 at v5.103.23; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.23.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a zone is found written by a URA borrow after a person's change (climate_write after an override_detected with human_interrupt), or a pre-arrival borrow ends as lease_expiry

refs.release_notes: When a person changes a zone's setpoint during a URA pre-cool, pre-heat or leftover compromise, URA now ends its temporary change without writing, and the arrester handles it as a normal manual override (grace, compromise, revert). URA remembers the interrupt (saved across restarts and Carrier dropouts) and won't start a new pre-cool or pre-heat on that zone until it leaves manual. Pre-arrival pre-cool writes once from the normal setting (no more 2-degree steps), ends when the person arrives, when the new 35 · Pre-Arrival Window (min) runs out, or on an interrupt, and never runs to the 2-hour cap. An interrupted pre-arrival reverts to Home (or Sleep at night). Also: compromise revert no longer re-pins manual, a restart mid-nudge no longer restores manual, and a reloading room no longer resets its zone's occupied clock.
